title: Seismicity and ground displacement
caption: Partial contextual reconstruction. A: external routine catalog, 16,046 located events and five Md>=4 stars. B: 114 leveling surveys (circles), 13 source-provided estimates (triangles), one source-provided reconstruction (cross), and daily GNSS through 20 March 2025; extension beyond 2023 shaded. Historical estimates are not raw observations or reconstructions made here. C: all routine monthly counts and cumulative Md>0.2; March includes days 1--20 only. Routine events are not independent detections. Datum joining is an assumption; basemap and live snapshot differ from the publication.

title: Recorded station availability
caption: Partial: 825 processed files, 26 station names and 7807.737 channel-hours after union of overlapping intervals. Empty intervals are not connected or counted as coverage.

title: Station locations
caption: Partial station inventory: 51 released identifiers audited against official study-period response epochs. Filled triangles: 42 official coordinate matches; open triangles: 9 released coordinates with unresolved epochs or channel codes. Two coincident-coordinate pairs remain distinct identifiers. No verified geographic outlier. Local WGS84 projection and clipped coastline; the original 48-instrument membership is not established.

title: Training examples
missing: Panels A--D require the specified training traces, annotations and augmentation examples. These were not reconstructed; downstream use of trained weights is not retraining.
caption: Noise, single-event and overlapping-event training examples are not reproduced.

title: PhaseNet benchmark examples
missing: S4B: exact CMIS noise-window timing and reference labels are unavailable. Other calendar-window diagnostics are not inserted as that panel.
caption: Partial S4A inference comparison on original CSOB observations, 20 May 2024 20:10:03--20:12:03 UTC. The caption's two-hour offset is interpreted literally; exact published alignment is unverified. Original weights: 5 P and 5 S; retrained weights: 6 P and 10 S. No labeled accuracy or retraining claim.

title: Routine-catalog locations
caption: External routine-catalog data, independently selected and plotted: 12,503 located events, 21 January 2022--20 March 2025. This is 420 more than the published historical snapshot. No author-derived catalog is used to adjust that difference; these are not independent detections.

title: Initial VELEST locations
missing: No accepted current result. For S6, the unverified background grid and dependent previous pilot were quarantined; alternative-profile arithmetic tests are not validated locations. No older output is substituted.
caption: Not reproduced at the current checkpoint.

title: Location uncertainties
missing: Panels A--G require independently selected regional subsets, HypoDD SVD locations and coordinate uncertainties. None of these scientific inversions ran.
caption: Regional locations, uncertainty-versus-count panels and uncertainty distributions are not reproduced.

title: Magnitude calibration and frequency distribution
caption: Partial amplitude-ratio pilot: 119 provisional magnitudes from independent observations, with routine Md as the documented calibration prior. A is not an independent validation of that prior. B is a limited-sample histogram with a conditional likelihood estimate, not the full-period completeness or b-value result. Locations are initial associations, before final relocation.

caption: Panel C is partial: independently processed E3 CAAM/COLB observations. Onset alignment, display filtering and spectral settings differ or are incompletely specified. A, B and D have placeholders rather than substitute waveforms.
